title: img2threejs/img2threejs
claim: img2threejs/img2threejs — Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token
why_good: Rebuilds a reference image's object as clean, procedural Three.js code — bridges 2D references to editable 3D, a real gap for web/3D devs.
value: Usage API for design/3D tools and agencies turning images into editable scenes; per-generation pricing.
risk: Image-to-3D is a hot, hard research area; quality/consistency must beat the fast-moving 3D-gen models.

zh.claim: img2threejs/img2threejs —— 把参考图里的物体重建为纯代码、程序化、带质量门的 Three.js。
zh.why_good: 把参考图的物体重建成干净的程序化 Three.js 代码——把 2D 参考桥接到可编辑 3D,对 web/3D 开发者是真实缺口。
zh.value: 给 把图变成可编辑场景 的设计/3D 工具和代理商做按量 API:按生成计费。
zh.risk: 图生 3D 是热门且难的研究区;质量/一致性要胜过快速迭代的 3D 生成模型。
